meta.name: claude
meta.description: Anthropic Claude models via inference.sh CLI. Models: Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Claude Haiku 5.5, plus Claude Code variants that run on your own Claude Pro/Max plan. 1M context, 128k output, thinking with effort, vision, tool use, structured output. Use for: coding, agents, reasoning, long documents, summarization, image understanding, chat. Triggers: claude, anthropic, claude api, claude fable, claude opus, claude sonnet, claude haiku, opus 5.5, sonnet 5.5, haiku 5.5, fable 5.1, claude code, claude pro, claude max, setup-token, anthropic api, claude subscription
